limitations: Missing reply, READY or ARM is a diagnostic observation failure, not automatic invalidation of raw capture.
A successful private ARM write proves PC-local acceptance only; MCU ARM acceptance comes from JTAG.
No parameter, flight-command, RF-rate or product timeout changes are performed.
The safe outer must perform JTAG acquisition and mandatory accepted R18 restoration.
Application Read pause does not prove physical USB IN suppression; Windows may prefetch.
No comparison-period MCU snapshot is acquired. A first failure latched before intervention is not an intervention outcome.
Read, USB pickup, RF delivery and product acceptance remain distinct. PC/MCU physical cause requires bounded event/USB-transfer evidence.
Local write API acceptance is not Pixhawk or RF delivery proof.
Native read completion timestamps define receive windows; no physical response causal proof is asserted.
Unknown messages are skipped at declared frame boundaries, not scanned for nested magic.
CRC validation is limited to PARAM_VALUE #22; skipped messages are not certified.
Signed PARAM_VALUE is unsupported, not authenticated.
Snapshot completeness requires an explicit caller native-reader watermark.
No MCU clock correlation or product acceptance is inferred.
